title: Diploma In Logistics And Supply Chain Management (Level 5)
description: A comprehensive programme designed to enhance strategic, operational, and managerial expertise in logistics and supply chain.
longDescription: The Diploma in Logistics and Supply Chain Management (Level 5) provides in-depth knowledge of essential supply chain practices, strategies, and processes. It equips learners with the ability to evaluate and manage procurement, inventory, and financial aspects of logistics operations. The course emphasizes both theoretical frameworks and practical applications within global and contemporary contexts. Learners will gain insights into strategic decision-making and operational efficiency for improved organizational performance. By integrating case studies and real-world examples, the program ensures learners are prepared to address challenges in dynamic supply chain environments.
courseDetails: This programme covers the principles and practices of logistics and supply chain management, including strategy, procurement, inventory, and financial planning. It highlights the global nature of supply chains and the challenges of managing them effectively in diverse contexts. Learners will develop critical thinking and analytical skills to evaluate modern supply chain issues. The course prepares participants for mid-to-senior-level roles in logistics, procurement, and supply chain operations across industries.

entry: For entry into Level 5 Diploma in Supply Chain Management, learners must possess the following:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Result can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Result. (This is assessed on a case by case basis)
* Learner must be 18 years or older at the start of the Course.
* Mature Learners (21 years or older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
